evidence_items.locator: Caption in 'Growth of Unreliable AI-generated News Sites in 2023'
evidence_items.explanation: NewsGuard reports growth from 49 identified domains in May to over 600 in December, using criteria that include inadequate human oversight. These are identified sites, not comparable counts of erroneous articles accepted by over-trusting editors; deliberate misinformation also falls within the report's scope.
